text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E soon after buying it at a loss taught me to decide in advance what would justify selling, rather than letting a short-term loss make the decision for me.","Adding to Stocks A and B after their prices fell did not guarantee a recovery; I should not treat a lower price alone as a reason to buy more.","Several months of holding through declines showed me that I need to review whether my portfolio risk still suits my goal, not just watch account value fluctuate."]}
